name: GetCredentials
label: Get Credential Manager Credentials
description: Retrieves stored credentials from Windows Credential Manager for a specified target.

fields.name: TargetName
fields.label: Target Name
fields.description: The name of the credential target to retrieve from Credential Manager.

fields.name: AccountName
fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: The username associated with the retrieved credential.

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Secure Password
fields.description: The password associated with the retrieved credential, returned as a SecureString.
